title: Mario finds his right B-52 pilot glove missing from his bag
place_text: Ellsworth AFB / Mario's home, Rapid City, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I did everything. And my left hand glove was there, but the right hand glove is gone.

I had not even thought about the mittens after that night—those heavy Air Force-issue gloves with open fingers, so you could fire a weapon—but, when he said that, I ran to my ditty bag to check and they were not there.

plain: After the 1977 night at the missile site, the former Air Force security guard Mario Woods says he checked his bag and found a glove gone, a small physical sign that something happened in the time he cannot account for. On the show he tells Michels that of his pair of B-52 pilot gloves the left was still there but the right was missing. In the account he wrote for the writer Robert Hastings, published on 10 September 2017, it was both "mittens", "those heavy Air Force-issue gloves with open fingers, so you could fire a weapon", that "were not there" when he ran to his ditty bag after a man mentioned them, so the two tellings differ on which gloves and how many.
